name: EOD 2026-09-11
body:
> Eod · 2026-09-11

Status tracker for the Friday 9/11 EOD, last checked Monday 9/14 with live site checks, a read-only Google Ads check and change logs. Each item is marked DONE, TODAY, WAITING, OPEN, DECIDE or CONFIRM.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Done: GA4 now sends to the Arizona property (Utah tag removed); 4 titles changed to "Summit Plumbing Pros"; Fountain Hills emergency 301; broken sitemap entry removed; Locations page redesign live; 4 quota-blocked indexing requests completed 9/14; /drain-cleaning/ title changed to "Drain Cleaning in the Phoenix Valley".
- Decide: 219 unsafe OTTO changes waiting in Search Atlas (OTTO pixel not on the live site; reject before anyone enables it).
- Confirm: GA4 Realtime in the AZ property; whether the plugin FYI note went to Scott; gas line work claims on two pages (ask Scott).
- Backlog: unverified "Navien-certified" and "Same-Day" claims on /free-tankless-quote/; OTTO knowledge graph phone mismatch; homepage duplicate H1 and long meta; mobile speed 69.

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- Done: hidden OTTO text removed (36 pages plus /contact/); phone buttons dial; wrong vacation rental and Course schema removed.
- Decide: 122 hidden "dynamic indexing" links still on the homepage (needs approval to turn off in OTTO); Indexing Phase 1 plan for 26 pages.
- Waiting: Buckeye SEO test checkpoint 9/16 then 9/30; full review 10/9.
- Backlog: sitemap cleanup, 3 key pages not indexed, GBP website link on http with UTM, striking-distance queries, wrong-city image alts on 36 pages.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Urgent: Google Ads 0 conversions since Sep 4 (140 clicks, $1,291.77 from Sep 4 to 13). The "WhatConverts Conversion" action had no uploads Sep 4 to 10, then late uploads; on Sep 13, 4 rejected (2 too old, 2 gbraid/wbraid on a "One" count action). See [WhatConverts](lib:brain-whatconverts).
- Recommendation for Kim/Scott to apply manually: ask Scott for leads Sep 4 to 13, change the action Count from One to Every, check the upload schedule, ask whether LP Test campaigns were paused on purpose.
- Open: GA4 has no key events; GA4 tag missing on /pipelining/ and /free-sewer-inspection/.
- Done: hidden OTTO text off, Service schema on the camera page. 30-issue SEO tracker: 3 done, 2 in progress, 25 open.

# TAG CRM
- Feature requests open: AI Visibility, Alphalete date range, GA4 for 3 clients, branded keyword bucketing. See [TAG CRM](lib:brain-tag-crm).

# Follow-ups
- Daily GBP photo posts (Summit, Pipeliners).
- Summit GSC check about 9/24, full review 10/2. Pipeliners review 10/9.
